asp_seam_watcher: I'm Tomak Redhoof, and I watch the Seam up in the high basin, north of camp. Stand on it with one foot in red dust and the other in leaf mould. The line's that sharp, and nothing has grown across it.
asp_rim_runner: I'm Ash Winterfall. I run the chutes on the rim north of camp, and everyone tells me not to. They're the only ground up there that stays swept, and a swept path is a fast one if you aren't slow.
asp_gate_scout: I'm Garuk Emberhide, scout for the high gate at the top of the basin. The Warchief wants to know what we border now. I've been up there a season and my answer is still 'a mountain', which he won't like.
asp_meadow_scout: I'm Owen Tallgrass. I scout Elkhorn, the meadow downslope south of camp. It's the only place in this zone where you can see anything. Everywhere else is trees, and the trees are all the same trees.
asp_bench_warden: I'm Gelt Rivermane. I keep the Beaverdam Benches, far down the valley south of camp. The beavers had that valley before we did and they've done more with it. You came off that blue world, didn't you? Do they have beavers there? Nobody can ever tell me.
